scenes.caption: Sewage plants built. Is the river cleaner?
scenes.narration: Thousands of crores have been sanctioned to clean the Ganga. Capacity is the easy number. What else do we know?

scenes.title: Sewage treatment capacity, million litres a day
scenes.caption: Built is not the same as running.
scenes.narration: Two hundred nineteen sewerage projects, worth about thirty six thousand crore rupees, were sanctioned. A hundred forty six are complete, creating about two thirds of the planned capacity.

scenes.kicker: Uttarakhand audit by the CAG, 2018 to 2023
scenes.label: treatment plants inspected met the NGT's standards (Jan to Mar 2023)
scenes.narration: But an audit in Uttarakhand found only five of forty four plants it inspected met the green tribunal's standards.

scenes.kicker: Two official readings of one river
scenes.caption: Prayagraj 2025: both statements may be true. Median vs single readings.
scenes.narration: And two official statements about Prayagraj water quality differ. Both may be true, one using medians, the other individual readings.
